Package dev.despical.portbridge.config

package dev.despical.portbridge.config
Strict configuration loading and immutable bridge settings.

The loader resolves the running server's listener and validates types, ranges and timing relationships. Nested settings records can then be retained by asynchronous workers without accessing server configuration.
